game_title: Range Check Bridge – Fish Market Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Coastal Port – Fish Market, a fish market full of crates: the shipwright must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Range Check Bridge: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross.
theme: Coastal Port – Fish Market: a fish market full of crates
core_gameplay_loop: In Fish Market, repeat each round: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the shipwright ahead. Then check the bridge_load value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ferry by solving code steps involving bridge_load that move the shipwright forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ferry first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 7 (applied tier): Range Check Bridge
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Check Bridge' (Week 3 slot 8), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Fish Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge_load changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Fish Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
